Hi Ava —

Thanks again for yesterday's walkthrough. We want to accelerate evaluation and have a concrete timeline to present at our July 22 exec review. Key asks:
- A short MAP we can show leadership with milestone dates and acceptance criteria
- A draft of committed monthly token (TPM) targets if we decide to scale in Q4
- Any provisional credit/discounts tied to milestone completion

Can you send a concise plan and a simple table with month-by-month TPM targets for a 6-month ramp? Also, legal wants a sample EULA/terms highlight for data handling.

From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + evaluation goals — MAP draft + TPM table

Hi Sara —

Thanks for the clear asks. Draft MAP attached (MAP-v3.xlsx) and below is a compact ramp proposal for the 6-month post-eval onramp. This is intentionally conservative at first, with a stepped increase and two checkpoint discounts tied to acceptance gates.

Proposed monthly TPM targets (post-eval, Month 1–6):
- Month 1: 120M tokens
- Month 2: 250M tokens
- Month 3: 500M tokens
- Month 4: 850M tokens
- Month 5: 1.2B tokens
- Month 6: 1.6B tokens

Pricing / credit structure (summary):
- Baseline list price applies to Month 1–2 while we validate throughput.
- 10% tier discount kicks in starting Month 3 once acceptance KPI A (latency & error rate) is met.
- Additional 7% uplift credit (applied retroactively) if Month 4 acceptance KPI B (quality/regression checks on 3 eval prompt sets) passes.
- We can offer a one-time onboarding credit of $25k if you sign the committed plan within 30 days of the exec review.

See the attached MAP-v3.xlsx for milestone dates (canary window, perf gates, rollout), acceptance criteria, and a mapping to PO/payment milestones. We've also included a redline-friendly term summary for legal.

Next steps:
1) Confirm these TPM targets and if your team prefers a steeper or gentler ramp.
2) If agreed, Ben will follow up with a draft commitment SOW and credit schedule.

Cheers,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

1) The discounts need a clearer trigger definition (what exactly constitutes KPI A/B passing and who signs off).
2) We prefer credits applied forward rather than retrospective credits — easier for our forecasting.
3) Can you show a conservative scenario and an aggressive scenario (different TPM curves) so we can scope budget impact?

Also copying our contracts inbox for visibility. Can Ben include a simple SOW with payment milestones tied to acceptance gate sign-offs? If so, we'll route for internal approvals faster.

Thanks,

LexaHealth

Subject: Re: MAP draft — conservative / aggressive TPM scenarios + SOW outline

Alex / Sara —

Great points. Attached is a 2-scenario TPM table embedded in MAP-v3 (Conservative vs Aggressive) and a short SOW outline that ties payments to three acceptance milestones:
- Milestone 1 (Canary & perf tests): sign-off by LexaHealth infra lead (KPI latency < 250ms p95, error rate < 0.5%)
- Milestone 2 (Quality eval): sign-off by Sara and product (three eval prompt sets, no regressions beyond agreed threshold)
- Milestone 3 (Production cutover): operational readiness and final PO acceptance

Credit mechanics updated per your request: credits will be applied forward to future invoices (not retroactive). We've introduced a holdback credit of 5% payable after Month 3 if the QoS gates are met, plus the $25k onboarding credit applied in Month 1 invoice.

Karthik — legal redlines are likely; loop in whichever clauses are needed for data residency/KMS.

If Lexa signs the committed SOW within 30 days of the July 22 exec review we'll hold the proposed rates for 90 days.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

Hi team —

Quick answers inline and attachments included. See attached DocuSign placeholder and the one-pager acceptance playbook.

1) Acceptance sign-off:
- Milestone 1: Lexa infra sign-off (email + perf dump) -> Redwood counter-sign (ops-verification).
- Milestone 2: Sara (product) sign-off (eval report + regression summary) -> Redwood acknowledges in writing.
- Milestone 3: Prod cutover: Lexa ops + Redwood ops co-signed checklist.

2) Data handling blurb (for privacy team):
- Redwood will persist customer-generated inference logs for 90 days by default in a customer-segregated store in us-west-2. Logs retained for troubleshooting and quality monitoring. Persistent storage is optional and can be disabled; encrypted at rest (KMS customer-managed option available).

3) PO placeholder (conservative scenario):
- Estimated 6-month committed spend: $345,000 (conservative TPM curve, includes onboarding credit of $25k applied in Month 1). Exact line items in SOW.

We can convert this to a DocuSign SOW once Lexa confirms the conservative curve. I attached DocuSign-LEX-2026-07.pdf as a placeholder.

Ben / Ava — let me know if you want me to seed the HubSpot opportunity with these fields.

Thanks,
